# FDG7055

> DO derive exceptions from `System.Exception` or one of the other common base exceptions.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.4 Designing Custom Exceptions.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Not checked: C# requires thrown and caught types to derive from System.Exception (CS0155). Which bases count as common is judgment; deriving from ApplicationException is FDG7040 (CA1058).
